integrity: The grading, twist, color bracket, involution condition, Nijenhuis identity, eigenspace criterion, and centroid condition are reconstructed directly. An exhaustive checker replays all 32 commuting involutions and independently confirms the classification.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only the source's five-dimensional Example 3.1/6.1.
It classifies degree-zero involutions commuting with the twist, as required for product structures, not arbitrary Nijenhuis operators.
Characteristic zero is retained from the source.
title: Example 6.1 is product but not strict: complete involutive product census
